outcome: Severe maternal adverse outcome (ICU admission, acute respiratory distress syndrome, advanced oxygen supplementation, maternal death)
cohort: Unvaccinated pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 in France and Switzerland between March 2020 and September 2022 (n=1953)
finding: Compared to the pre-Delta period, the Delta variant was associated with a higher risk of severe maternal adverse outcomes, while the Omicron variant was associated with a lower risk.
